summary: Wave 1 Floating AI Agent tested end-to-end. All 13 backend pytest cases (chat, multi-turn, tool triggers, validation, auth, conversations CRUD, audit trail via psql, security) PASSED. Full frontend E2E flow (login → open drawer → suggestions → Shift+Enter newline → send with Enter → assistant reply with get_network_status tool badge → history panel → close drawer → no key leak → hidden on /login) PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: Login endpoint returns 'access_token' but some test agents may expect 'token'. Consider adding both keys for consistency.
AiController::destroyConversation could rely on FK cascade or explicit message deletion; verify migration cascade to avoid orphan ai_messages / ai_audit_logs rows.
FloatingAiAssistant.tsx is 334 lines — acceptable but bordering; consider extracting the drawer body / history panel for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None. Test conversations created via chat; one throwaway deleted by test_delete_then_404.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OpenAI key is real; keep chat calls minimal. Login returns data.access_token (not data.token). AI endpoints under /api/v1/ai/*. Audit rows are in table ai_audit_logs keyed by conversation_id. Frontend testids: ai-assistant-open-btn, ai-assistant-drawer, ai-assistant-close-btn, ai-input, ai-send-btn, ai-history-btn, ai-history-panel, ai-new-chat-btn, ai-suggestion-0..3, ai-msg-user-*, ai-msg-assistant-*.
